description: This file defines a sealed class RawUnicodeEncoding that extends the Encoding class, providing a custom implementation for encoding and decoding Unicode character data as bytes, specifically for glyph indexing within a PDF processing library.

classes.name: RawUnicodeEncoding
classes.description: A custom Unicode encoding for glyph indexing in PDF processing.

methods.name: GetByteCount
methods.description: Calculates the number of bytes needed to encode a given set of characters.

methods.name: GetBytes
methods.description: Encodes characters into bytes, representing each character as two bytes for glyph indexing.

methods.name: GetCharCount
methods.description: Calculates the number of characters produced from a byte array.

methods.name: GetChars
methods.description: Decodes bytes into characters, reconstructing each character from two bytes.

methods.name: GetMaxByteCount
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of bytes needed to encode a certain number of characters.

methods.name: GetMaxCharCount
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of characters that can be produced from a given number of bytes.
